record.label: V-residual instrument suite (1e-5-grade targets)
record.summary: The supervised target system for the variance channel: R-fields (truth-post-cov minus closure on card state) banked per layer for both nets at shared-draw 1e-5 truth; oracle depth curve priced (full v-channel = raw 1.25-1.46e-8; +4-6 pts/layer beyond L4); value metric = pushed-v; W-conventions nailed; truth pre-planes located (mps_planes l>=2); K21-Frobenius shown to be a null instrument at N=4e5.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed when every supply candidate can be graded in minutes against exact targets on both nets (done).

evidence.claim: vresid_field_rank{0035,0100}.npz + oracle arms dvhat_rank*_shorc*.npz + the depth-curve entry.

record.goal_path_summary: Measured exactly what the deployed estimator gets wrong about variance at every layer, on both test networks, precisely enough to grade any proposed fix in minutes — and priced what fixing each layer is worth, so effort goes where the points are.
